notablePrerequisites:
Arbor Elf does not have summoning sickness.
Darksteel Garrison attached to Arbor Elf.
description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, targeting itself.
Darksteel Garrison triggers, giving target creature +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Arbor Elf ability, untapping it.
Repeat.
